entries.title: Ovara
entries.subtitle: Helor System
entries.summary: A technologically mature human world with 29 sovereign states. REPLY begins in Merva, within the Kesra Basin.
entries.detail: The people of Ovara have their own histories, institutions, work and unanswered questions. In REPLY, an anomalous measurement must be investigated, documented and challenged without deciding an entire world's future in advance.

entries.title: Nali Solan
entries.subtitle: Merva · Ovara
entries.summary: A 29-year-old precision instrumentation specialist who refuses to dismiss evidence that familiar explanations cannot resolve.
entries.detail: Nali's professional world depends on reliable records and reproducible measurement. Preserving an unresolved result is the beginning of a scientific and profoundly human question.

entries.title: Neral
entries.subtitle: Irsen System
entries.summary: A sovereign, inhabited human world linked with Veyra by mature Road infrastructure, with its own history and culture.
entries.detail: Road travel has become an established part of ordinary life for a civilization connected across worlds. This does not make Neral a colony of Veyra, nor erase Neral's separate political and cultural identity.

entries.title: Veyra
entries.subtitle: Connected civilization
entries.summary: An established human world where travel to Neral through an engineered Road belongs to everyday infrastructure.
entries.detail: Mature Road systems rely on engineering, maintenance and institutions. The lives of people on Veyra still revolve around ordinary choices, labor, relationships and civic obligations.

entries.title: Merva
entries.subtitle: Ordan Republic · Ovara
entries.summary: A major city in Ovara's Kesra Basin, shaped by canals, water management, universities, markets and technical work.
entries.detail: Merva's streets and neighborhoods mix older canal alignments with modern electric transit, laboratories, clinics, housing and industry. Water storage and flood management are ordinary parts of civic life. The opening of REPLY takes place in a functioning city, not a catastrophe or an empty scientific outpost.
entries.keywords: Kesra Basin city district water infrastructure transit science Ovara

entries.title: Serein Skygate
entries.subtitle: Veyra · Orbital gate-city
entries.summary: The inhabited Veyran gate-city at one end of the established Veyra–Neral Open Road.
entries.detail: Serein Skygate combines a controlled Road boundary with inhabited districts, transit, freight, docking and precision operations. It is one engineered endpoint of a two-ended system, not a free-floating portal. Its civic life continues alongside the machinery.
entries.keywords: Serein Gate Veyra station orbital city Road Frame transit engineering

entries.title: Neral Skygate
entries.subtitle: Neral · Orbital gate-city
entries.summary: The Neran endpoint of the same mature Open Road, with locally distinct architecture, civic space and engineering traditions.
entries.detail: The two Skygates share operating interfaces and safety standards, but Neral's inhabited gate-city reflects Neran history and culture. It is not a visual copy of Serein Skygate and is not an outpost of Veyra.
entries.keywords: Neral Gate Neran endpoint orbit civic engineering Road

entries.title: Open Road
entries.subtitle: Veyra–Neral · Paired endpoints
entries.summary: A maintained, two-ended connection between paired Skygates that carries ordinary passengers, vehicles and cargo.
entries.detail: Each endpoint has its own inhabited gate-city and working systems for measurement, control, power, cooling and transit. An Open Road does not dial arbitrary worlds or operate from one side alone. Its ordinary use depends on continuous cooperation and engineering.
entries.keywords: paired Skygates passage travel freight infrastructure boundary metrology
